purpose: Teach: 添削/並列/倍率/増資/商取引/仮称/用具/インプット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、原稿の添削を進めろ
lines.style: Clipped, directive. Flat delivery without room for negotiation. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Eyes forward, no flourish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。データを並列に処理しております
lines.en: Yes. We're processing the data in parallel.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Steady pace, measured. A professional confirming competence without overselling. Slight formal distance maintained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、応募倍率を上げる施策を検討しろ
lines.en: Develop measures to increase the application rate.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Slightly faster than the first order. Executive weight behind each word. Brief silence after — the kind that expects acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規増資の準備を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're preparing for the new capital raise.
lines.style: Businesslike confirmation. Faster tempo than the previous response. Shows momentum, readiness. Professional without deference.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商取引の透明性を保て
lines.en: Maintain transparency in all commercial dealings.
lines.style: Firm, measured delivery. The emphasis falls on 'transparency' — a value being asserted. Slight lean forward in posture. Not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新プロジェクトの仮称を決めました
lines.en: Yes. We've finalized the working title for the new project.
lines.style: Confirmation with a note of progress. Steady pace. The tone of someone reporting forward momentum without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員用具の補充を確認しろ
lines.style: Brief, procedural. Quieter than the previous directives — almost routine. Still carries authority but less weight. Efficient, no elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場のインプットを社員と共有しております
lines.en: Yes. We've been sharing market insights with the team.
lines.style: Polished closing statement. Calm, assured tone. Shows initiative without claiming credit. Professional closure — the final word of someone doing the job well.
